summary: Verify a clean fixture score before merging this contract change
body: This changes a listed coachman-contract file (`scripts/run coachman-contract BASE HEAD` reports `yes skills/postmaster/coachman.md`). The required fixture must be dispatched from this branch and score clean before merge, and no clean score is verified in this review; please provide that score before treating the change as ready ([AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md#L35-L40)).

summary: Use the default timeout for these fast tests
body: This suite adds multiple 15s and 30s per-test overrides for checks that complete in milliseconds to a few seconds. The project sets a 60s default and requires custom limits only when a test needs longer; remove these lower overrides to follow [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md#L282-L288) and avoid needless failures under load.
